response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.bats AS batting_hand, c.cnt AS fielding_count, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share_of_total, c.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt ORDER BY c.cnt DESC
